title.narrative: Inclusive Education for Blind Children in Sierra Leone

description.narrative: Children with disabilities are marginalised by both their parents and the state in Sierra Leone and the vast majority are excluded from school. The UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities is not being implemented; schools are not equipped to deal with disabled children; mainstream teachers are not trained in working with CWD; and administrators and able-bodied children are often unsympathetic to their plight. Our project will determine the parameters for Inclusive Education in Sierra Leone. We will carry out studies to estimate the numbers of blind children in four chiefdoms in Southern Bombali, and investigate both the institutional and social barriers to educating BC in one indicative city, Makeni. We will engage in active research/consultation with local stakeholders (parents, teachers & school principals) as well as Inclusive Education specialists in the UK, and pilot initiatives in local schools that will explore how best these barriers can be reduced/overcome. The output of this project will be the development of a coherent proposal for a project that will both promote Inclusive Education in Makeni and serve as a blue print for initiatives in other centres of population in Sierra Leone.
